name: io.github.mockzilla/mockzilla-mcp
description: Mock OpenAPI specs locally, or log in to deploy hosted mocks on mockzilla.org from your MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: MOCKZILLA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API key (mz_*) to use instead of logging in with the login tool, for machines without a browser. Leave unset to log in from your agent.

environmentVariables.name: MOCKZILLA_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the hosted MCP endpoint (staging or local development). Defaults to https://platform.mockzilla.org/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: MOCKZILLA_MANAGED_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Preferred port for the local managed mock server. Defaults to 2200; falls back to a kernel-picked port if busy.
